labels: A smooth skirt widens from its fitted waistband to its hem, with continuous outward-slanting side seams and an unpleated front.; 매끈한 치마가 맞는 허리단에서 밑단까지 넓어지고 옆선이 연속해서 바깥으로 기울며 앞면에 의도적 플리츠는 없다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A smooth skirt widens from its fitted waistband to its hem, with continuous outward-slanting side seams and an unpleated front.
aliases: 주름 없는 A라인 윤곽
